name: llm-meter
description: Status bar meter for Ollama Cloud usage limits. Local install only, no telemetry, no auto-update.

scripts.package: node scripts/preflight.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@2 package --out dist/llm-meter.vsix --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links
